url.description: Target URL of the HTTP request

headers.description: Headers to use when sending the requests. e.g. {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

auth_username.description: Username for Basic and Digest authentications

auth_password.description: Password for Basic and Digest authentications

data.description: The body to attach to the request

json.description: The JSON to attach as the request body

params.description: Query string parameters to append to the URL

fail_on_http_error.description: Fail when the HTTP query returns in error. Default to true.

verify_ssl.description: Whether the SSL certificate must be verified. Default to true.

description: Requests a resource at a specified URL and returns the response as Raw or JSON
name: Request URL

reason.description: Textual reason phrase of the HTTP status (for example: Not Found, OK).

status_code.description: Numeric HTTP status code returned by the server.

url.description: Final URL of the requested resource.

headers.description: Response headers returned by the server.

encoding.description: Character encoding detected for the response body.

elapsed.description: Elapsed time in seconds between sending the request and receiving the response.

json.description: Response body parsed as JSON when available.
